source_rights_scope: NLP research-only feasibility audit; preserve provider notice. No corpus redistribution or model training. Original author permission/source URL limitations remain unresolved.
selection_rule: Lowest canonical SHA-256([20261105, document_id]) among 3915 fixed public train IDs minus the previous 50. No public dev/test body or membership access.
target_rule: One span per document and policy: among contiguous spans of that policy containing a CJK unified ideograph, choose the lowest canonical SHA-256([20261105, document_id, policy, annotation_unit_index, start_morpheme, end_morpheme]). Select before reading validation or candidate access. Basic phrases are '+' KNP annotation units. Never cross EOS or split S-ID boundaries.
surface_reading_rule: Concatenate original annotated surfaces/readings exactly. No NFKC, guessed pronunciation, fallback reading, or silent alternative selection. Any @ annotation in the span remains unresolved. Preserve unavailable policy slots as no_target.
context_rule: At most 64 original characters preceding the target inside the same annotation unit; synthetic source prefix, not observed session context. No minimum context length. No future context in model inputs.
reading_contract: Forward only nonempty hiragana/long-vowel readings <=128 characters and surfaces <=256 characters. Record whether within existing model bounds reading<=32/surface<=32 separately. Every slot remains in reports.

acquisition.rate_limit_policy: Stop on 429/403 or Retry-After, mark remaining slots not_attempted; no retry or replacement

converter.reading_reuse: Same reading with immutable pure converter/dictionary; no user dictionary or context input

history_audit: Fixed six historical source generations, original frozen-input hashes without parsing labels, all three data-growth source extractions, and prior 50 KWDLC inputs/source units. Exact source/paragraph/sentence/input and Jaccard>=0.8 source closure. Record coverage limits; do not remove pilot rows or claim independent Gold.
